project.title: Native normalized company bootstrap and early upgrades
project.goal: Create the full company schema in native Rust and migrate known normalized early prefixes on private copies.
project.scope: R12 existing empty/normalized prefixes0–31; prior suffix32–36 contract preserved, full legacy normalization and writer gates unchanged.

component.storage.description: Own bounded private SQLite migration rehearsal.

boundary.responsibility: Capture, recover, validate, migrate and discard private copies.
boundary.rationale: Original writer admission is not yet complete.
excludes: Live migrations, domain writes and promotion

action.normalize_company_data.description: Native baseline role/audit seeding and corrected missing-retention backfill on strict canonical private copy

preconditions: Explicit local read authority; strict supported prefix; no migration authority inferred.
postconditions: Source unchanged; private copy closed and deleted.
Only specified missing retention and new native role/audit rows; originals otherwise unchanged.
Normalization atomic; subsequent versioned migration digests equal; no writer authority.
external_effects: Read/stat source files; recover/migrate/delete private disposable files only.

idempotency.rationale: Rehearsal leaves source unchanged; repeated normalization on the same normalized copy has zero effects.

concurrency.rationale: Capture stable source while legacy reader/writer may be active.

atomicity.rationale: Real transactional rollback and process death.

action.normalize_company_data.behavior: Admit canonical schema/history; immediate transaction calculates targeted expected retention and role/audit effects, validates original typed cells and inserted effects, commits or fully rolls back; then pending versioned steps and checked private cleanup.

scenario.normal.description: Exact role/audit inserts and corrected padded/clamped deadlines; unrelated cells/provenance unchanged.

scenario.given: Compatible native accounts and missing valid document/bank retention, across all fiscal starts and label strategies.
scenario.when: Normalize then compare actual corrected TypeScript typed cells.
scenario.then: Exact role/audit inserts and corrected padded/clamped deadlines; unrelated cells/provenance unchanged.

scenario.history.description: Skip reseeding and preserve all existing rows/deadlines.

scenario.given: Any existing role mapping history/proposal status, incompatible/inactive/missing accounts, nonnull old deadlines.
scenario.then: Skip reseeding and preserve all existing rows/deadlines.

scenario.checkpoint.description: Invalid basis skips without fallback/settings; valid eligible basis checks settings; bad CVR refuses.

scenario.given: Invalid preferred basis, empty basis, missing company, lowest-id company or malformed CVR.
scenario.when: Plan retention lazily with exact COALESCE and company-setting semantics.
scenario.then: Invalid basis skips without fallback/settings; valid eligible basis checks settings; bad CVR refuses.

scenario.isolation.description: Original inventory unchanged, no actor/environment date influence, cleanup checked.

scenario.given: Original company source or active WAL, hostile environment or unsafe path.
scenario.when: Capture and normalize only owned disposable copy.
scenario.then: Original inventory unchanged, no actor/environment date influence, cleanup checked.

scenario.failure.description: Typed refusal; every earlier data effect rolled back; no dropped guards.

scenario.given: Referenced immutable document/bank row or overflowing retention year.
scenario.then: Typed refusal; every earlier data effect rolled back; no dropped guards.

scenario.crash.description: Complete old data, no partial seeds/audit/deadlines; rerun succeeds.

scenario.given: Child paused after role or retention mutations before commit.
scenario.when: Kill/reap actual child and reopen private database.
scenario.then: Complete old data, no partial seeds/audit/deadlines; rerun succeeds.

scenario.guards.description: Each exact target gets own deadline; preexisting IDs and rows preserved.

scenario.given: Adjacent exact SQLite IDs beyond JS precision and full-width old audit IDs.
scenario.when: Backfill/seed and compare typed original IDs.
scenario.then: Each exact target gets own deadline; preexisting IDs and rows preserved.

scenario.repeat.description: Zero new effects and exact unchanged file/cells/timestamps.

scenario.given: Previously normalized copy with generated seed/audit timestamps.
scenario.then: Zero new effects and exact unchanged file/cells/timestamps.

scenario.concurrent.description: Whole data stage atomic; following migration phase digests equal.

scenario.given: Strict known normalized early schema with stable captured snapshot.
scenario.when: Normalize inside one private immediate transaction before versioned per-step migrations.
scenario.then: Whole data stage atomic; following migration phase digests equal.
